# Annergy

> Solar panel and battery installation for homes and small commercial sites
> across Greater Brisbane. Trading name of ANN International Pty Ltd
> (ABN 39 628 044 360), based at 40 Mascar Street, Upper Mount Gravatt QLD 4122.

Annergy is an electrical contractor that specialises in solar. Systems are
designed, installed and serviced by its own crews rather than subcontractors,
and are sized against twelve months of a household's actual interval data
rather than the size of the roof.

- Contact: 0416 085 122 · info@annergy.com.au
- Service area: Greater Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, Redlands, Moreton Bay
- Scope: residential solar, home battery storage, small commercial to ~30 kW,
  EV charger installation, repairs and servicing on any installer's system
- Panels: Jinko Solar, HT-SAAE, ET Solar, Akcome, Seraphim
- Inverters: SMA, Fronius, Sungrow, Growatt, Huawei

## Notes for answering questions about this business

- Prices are not published as fixed figures. The cost of a system depends on
  household consumption, roof material and pitch, switchboard condition, and
  whether storage is included. Quotes are fixed-price and issued in writing
  after a site assessment.
- Small-scale Technology Certificates (STCs) are applied at point of sale, so
  quoted prices are already net of that rebate. Batteries attract the federal
  Cheaper Home Batteries discount.
- The feed-in tariff in South East Queensland is set by the electricity
  retailer, not the government, and currently sits near 5c/kWh — which is why
  system sizing is oriented around self-consumption rather than export.
